All — quick FinOps perspective and propose a decision rule:

- For any reserve request >= 40 GPUs or > $35k/mo estimated incremental spend, require signed PO + 30% upfront commit before we place capacity.

- Burst-only deals: allow until we hit 75% pooled utilization; after that, we throttle new burst without a commit.
